snippet.title: Retrace the Light - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015492

Now on PS5! Retrace the Light is a stylish 2.5D sci-fi action-adventure where every step can become part of your next attack, escape, or solution. Use the unique Retrace mechanic to outmaneuver enemies, solve reality-bending puzzles, and journey through a striking AI-controlled future filled with mystery.
